lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 12-16 high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are arranged in three primary longitudinal rows posterior to the gill slits. The central row displays the highest diameter and pixel intensity, while the dorsal-most row contains smaller, more widely spaced blobs.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal carinae and longitudinal rows of blobs, forming a rectangular grid-like configuration where blobs serve as high-intensity anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct linear ridges are visible running horizontally across the upper third of the flank. These features exhibit a sharp vertical gradient, with a high-luminance upper edge and a high-contrast shadow on the inferior side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin displays a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs (approximately 6-8 distinct points) localized primarily toward the anterior leading edge of the fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct elongated dark silhouette, consistent with a remora (Echeneidae), is attached to the ventral surface posterior to the right pectoral fin.
